crossRefs.note: Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, each took his censer, and put fire in it, and laid incense on it, and offered…
He struck of the men of Beth Shemesh, because they had looked into Yahweh’s ark, he struck fifty thousand seventy of…
Yahweh’s anger burned against Uzza, and he struck him, because he put his hand on the ark; and he died there before God.
Then David said, “No one ought to carry God’s ark but the Levites. For Yahweh has chosen them to carry God’s ark, and…
For because you didn’t carry it at first, Yahweh our God broke out in anger against us, because we didn’t seek him…
For this cause many among you are weak and sickly, and not a few sleep.

parallels.note: Yahweh’s anger burned against Uzza, and he struck him, because he put his hand on the ark; and he died there before God.

people.name: Uzzah
people.line: Died while moving the ark; place named after him

translations.web: Yahweh’s anger burned against Uzzah; and God struck him there for his error; and he died there by God’s ark.
translations.bsb: And the anger of the LORD burned against Uzzah, and God struck him down on the spot for his irreverence, and he died there beside the ark of God.
translations.kjv: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Uzzah; and God smote him there for his error; and there he died by the ark of God.
translations.asv: And the anger of Jehovah was kindled against Uzzah; and God smote him there for his error; and there he died by the ark of God.
